conbody.p: With the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, touch SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceParking safety on the infotainment system.

li.p: Backward safety: It warns or assists in braking when there is a high risk of collision with pedestrians or objects in the rear direction.

note.p: When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist. Pay extra attention when you drive when the function is inactive. (If a Kia genuine Trailer Kit that can determine whether a trailer is connected is used)
With the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, Backward safety will be selected and Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist settings will be retained whenever the vehicle is restarted.
